Pair sum in a sorted array (two-sum)

Given a sorted array, determine whether two distinct elements sum to target.

Closest pair to target in a sorted array

Given a sorted array, find the pair whose sum is closest to target.

Palindrome verification

Determine whether a sequence reads identically from both directions.

Reverse array in-place

Reverse an array without allocating another array.

Container with most water (Leetcode)

Given an array `height` of `n` randomly ordered nonnegative integers, find the indices `l` and `r` maximizing the value of `min(height[l], height[r]) * (r - l)` (find container with largest area).
